title: SPAIN: +22 YEARS
subtitle: Life expectancy at birth, in years

lines.say: In 1950, a baby born in Spain could expect to live about 62 years. In Norway, almost 72.
The pandemic briefly puts Norway back in front.
But by 2023, Spain is ahead again: 83.7 years, against Norway's 83.3.
That's almost 22 extra years in one lifetime. The whole of Europe is in our full video.
